description: Current inventory of top-level files and directories directly under astrid/. This is a documentation artifact, not a runtime input.

classification_categories.public_facade: Part of the public SDK contract.
classification_categories.shared_library: Shared library or utility used across subsystems.
classification_categories.planned_absent: Canonical concept allowed by constants but not materialized on disk.

top_level_files.name: __main__.py
top_level_files.notes: Executable package gateway; delegates to astrid.gateway.main().

top_level_directories.name: audit
top_level_directories.notes: Run-local provenance ledger, graph, transport, and HTML report.

top_level_directories.name: core
top_level_directories.notes: Framework kernel. Pack machinery lives under astrid/core/pack/.

top_level_directories.name: elements
top_level_directories.notes: Allowed canonical concept; no astrid/elements/ directory exists on disk.

top_level_directories.name: gateway
top_level_directories.notes: CLI gateway facade and implementation modules: dispatch.py, help.py, project.py, wait.py.

top_level_directories.name: packs
top_level_directories.notes: Pack data only. Top-level Python modules are rejected except __init__.py.

top_level_directories.name: skills
top_level_directories.notes: Agent skill discovery, registry, and harness runtimes.

structure_constants_reference.rule: No top-level compatibility shim files remain. New top-level modules must be explicit canonical surfaces and added to astrid/structure.py.

pack_machinery_layout.rule: New pack machinery belongs in astrid/core/pack/*. astrid/packs/ is for pack data only.
